g.text: Where can plaintext, keys and the sole authoritative copy exist?
Every source and authority has its own storage/backup owner. Controller scratch must satisfy its signed memory profile: nonswappable by default, or explicitly
verified macOS encrypted swap for development. Gateway scratch holds ciphertext and permit plaintext only. Native reference uses two stateless controllers; local Git
requires one fenced writer. Operational endpoints use the same private mTLS app.
